thread:
rachel: FYI the SAST gating job flagged an evidence mismatch on PR #5890. The runner couldn't fetch the repo signing key from KMS (kms:AccessDenied). Anyone on keystore/CI side see this?
tom: saw the failure in nightly too. Logs show the signing call returned 403 and the token was the CI ephemeral token.
elena: quick check: did we recently change the conditional IAM binding for the `ci-service` account? We added time-window constraints last week.
rachel: yes, bindings updated Monday for the rotation test. If the window closed, we should fall back to the documented safe path. What does the merge gate currently do on attestation failure?
ops-bot: [automated] SAST merge gate failed for PR #5890. Reason: artifact attestation missing. Job: sast-signer-2026-03-21-2205. See /ci/logs/sast-signer-2026-03-21-2205.
tom: current behavior: gate blocks merge unless attestation is present. There is an internal doc referencing a manual "pending-attestation" label flow but it's rarely used.
elena: Proposed temporary flow: when KMS denies access, CI should automatically mark PR with `evidence:pending-attestation`, attach an evidence stub with fields: original_sha, attempted_key, kms_error, and prevent auto-merge. Also notify `sec-oncall` and open a backfill ticket.
rachel: that seems reasonable. Two technical requirements: 1) prevent privilege escalation by using an aux key without owner approval; 2) capture KMS response metadata so we can audit and triage.
tom: agree. For aux key usage we should require a dedicated PR approval from keystore team and a recorded justification. Not automatic.
elena: draft backfill CLI snippet for re-signing when primary key is available:```bash
gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=ci --key=repo-signer \
  --ciphertext-file=build/signature.tar.gz.enc --plaintext-file=build/signature.tar.gz
# re-run fingerprint and update evidence API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $EVID_TOKEN" -d '{"pr":5890,"status":"signed","signer":"repo-signer/versions/7"}' \
  https://internal-api.redwood/evidence/update
```
rachel: nice. Add an assertion in the backfill to verify the signer key id and to record `kms_response=AccessDenied` from the original attempt.
tom: runbook items: - who to page (sec-oncall M-F 9-5, infra-oncall nights/weekend), - escalation window (10m auto-notify then escalate), - labels to add (`evidence:pending-attestation`, `evidence:needs-backfill`), - template ticket for backfill.
elena: I'll open a short runbook PR and a CI patch. CI patch will: capture KMS error codes, add label, upload stub evidence blob, and post to channel. Backfill PR will be separate and will include audit fields: original_fingerprint, attempted_key_id, kms_error_code, re_sign_key_id, re_sign_timestamp.
ops-bot: [automated] Created incident record INC-2026-03-21-KMS-Evidence-Mismatch.
ci-bot: @channel PR #5890 labeled: evidence:pending-attestation. Notifying: @sec-oncall @infra-oncall.
rachel: thanks. Elena/Tom, assign the runbook and CI patches to me and I'll review quickly so we can un-block pending merges. :thumbsup:
elena: assigned. I'll include a smoke-check cron that validates the signer grant 24h before expiry and sends a warning to ops-alerts.
tom: one more ask: add a CI metric for frequency of KMS AccessDenied events so we can spot regressions.
rachel: adding that to the runbook checklist. Will update this thread with PR links.
